status: User-required measurement gate; not execution authorization or accepted new semantic policy.

mandatory: Same required outcomes and exact closed all-owner/caller scope before and after.

After readable production implementation is strictly lower; after implementation+maintained declarations is also strictly lower. Include new adapter/import/caller/type/error/manifest code and required retained TS routes.
Report removal of owned mechanisms and distinct compatibility/representation/lifecycle burdens, plus dependencies/upgrade qualification. Explain any worsening; no invented weighted score.
Readable formatting and real mechanism deletion reviewed independently. Minification, line joining, moves, generated output and moving code into test/support paths earn zero reduction.
Real consumers, independent oracles and decisive negative/error/authority/lifecycle controls pass at the claimed scope.
replacement_only.formula: net_source_delta = after_closed_scope_implementation_and_declarations - before_closed_scope_implementation_and_declarations; new helper and all integration costs are included; overlapping remedies are measured as one combined candidate, not summed.
replacement_only.future_candidate_status: No candidate was implemented; all future exact line totals/null deltas remain unmeasured. Gross deletion envelopes are upper source opportunities before integration cost, not net savings.

capability_and_correctness.rule: New capability and correction of existing required behavior get separate exact scope, source/lifecycle/dependency/runtime budget and acceptance. Their growth cannot be used to justify replacement-only failure or claimed as savings.
capability_and_correctness.budget_now: Unallocated; no new growth accepted or workers dispatched. Required original tasks and holds stay authoritative.

tests_and_evidence: Account separately; preserve independent golden/oracle/history. Smaller tests/docs/generated bytes do not satisfy production reduction.
measurement_basis: Reuse verified immutable baseline; current package tree and root lock/manifests match. Role-aware LF physical counts are source units, not complexity, execution or shipped footprint. Function/source envelopes are nonadditive.
